title: ICWSM-DataHub: a catalog and accessibility audit of ICWSM Dataset Track datasets (2020-2026)
description: A catalog of every ICWSM Dataset Track paper published 2020-2026, with attributes extracted from each paper by an LLM, operational FAIR indicators, and a live check of whether each dataset can still be downloaded and used. Includes CSV, Parquet and JSON files, a data dictionary and Croissant metadata. Code: MIT. Data: CC BY 4.0.
